newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Tuesday on reduced turnover.
A shares fell to $113 from $114.25 on Monday and B shares held steady at $118.
Turnover fell to 8,222 shares from 9,244 and value was $939,822 from $1,062,634.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None of the shares were traded in the last two weeks.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.16 percent to 84.50 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.42 percent to 982.48.
